title: Jubilant Portuguese Vegetable Skillet
description: A savory and festive lacto-vegetarian dish featuring ketchup and a variety of vegetables, cooked to perfection in an iron teppan skillet. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the iron teppan skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it starts to caramelize.
Add the sliced bell pepper and cook until it starts to soften.
Add the sliced zucchini and cook until it starts to tenderize.
In a small bowl, whisk together the ketchup, vegetable broth, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the ketchup mixture over the vegetables and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the crumbled feta cheese and cook until it starts to melt.
Use a spatula to fold the vegetables and cheese together.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes and serve hot.
